    1. attributeChanged(Optional)

Interface AttributeObserver

All Known Implementing Classes:
AnimatedAreaAnalysisCase, AnimatedAreaGeospatialAnalysisCase, BarChartAnalysisCase, LineChartsAnalysisCase, NeuralNetworkAnalysisCase, ObjectiveFunctionAnalysisCase, ParametricAnalysisCase, ScatterPlotAnalysisCase, SysMLBindingConnector, TradeOffAnalysisCase
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface AttributeObserver
The AttributeObserver is a functional interface for a value observer, i.e. an object that wants to be notified of a change in the value of ObservableAttribute implementations. Similar to the deprecated Observer in the Java API, the AttributeObserver implementation provides an implementation of a attributeChanged() operation that is called by the ObservableAttribute whose addAttributeObserver() operation was previously invoked. All SysMLAttributeTypes are ObservableAttributes thereby enabling their use as ends of the SysMLBindingConnector used to bind attributes in parts to attributes/parameters in analysis cases.

      void attributeChanged(Optional<String> attributeID)
      Invoked by an ObservableAttribute to notify this AttributeObserver of a change in the observed value.

      Note this method is provided to enable model execution. It is not part of the SysML standard. To the extent the SysML standard does not provide elements for executable modeling per se, SysMLinJava includes various model elements to enable model execution.
